title: tests.py fails when KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG is set in the environment: conftest does not clear it
goal: A test run with KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG set in the environment (a sandbox agent's sync gate, a developer shell) passes as without it: conftest clears KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG with the other leaky variables (bench_repro.LEAKY_ENV and test_bench.py's comparison follow), so test_authority.py's temporary roots read their own _backlog item directory, not the file the variable names
